topics.name: Orphan File Audit
topics.purpose: Define reconciliation of files that are not referenced, classified, generated by a declared toolchain step or intentionally retained as history/documentation.

semantics.orphan_rule: Orphan means a file has no declared canonical role, reference, generator relation or intentional repository purpose.
semantics.candidate_rule: Orphan status is a finding, not automatic deletion.
semantics.history_rule: Historical artifacts may be intentionally retained through explicit classification.
semantics.tooling_rule: Scripts/tools may be retained when their repository role is explicit.
semantics.authority_rule: Orphan detection does not authorize destructive cleanup.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.
